name: aria-agent
description: Aria dsh plugins: engine adapter, memo context memory, CubeSandbox agent sandbox with isolated persistent workspaces

scripts.test: bun test dsh/plugins/shared/test/*.test.ts dsh/plugins/aria-engine/test/*.test.ts dsh/plugins/aria-memo/test/*.test.ts dsh/plugins/aria-sandbox/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p dsh/plugins/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p dsh/plugins/aria-engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p dsh/plugins/aria-memo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p dsh/plugins/aria-sandbox/tsconfig.json
